infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is recorded when you start the day and when you check in at a shop, so a visit can be shown against the right shop.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to take the shelf photo and the day-start selfie that go with a visit.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a photo for a visit when you have already taken it.
